prompt:
Create ONE contextual writing-pose edit of THIS approved Buddy artwork. Preserve the SAME Buddy identity, light lavender colour/saturation, dense fine short plush fur, soft dimensional studio lighting, wide head proportions, thick pink-lined ears, glossy deep-black eyes, pink cheeks, cute smile, chubby body, feet and heart/toe pads. Do not redesign, darken, wash out, smooth into plastic, add a nose/eyebrows/fingers or alter the render style.
The REQUIRED change is a genuinely bowed writing head and securely held pen, NOT just moving white dots on an upright face. Rotate/pitch Buddy's head naturally DOWN toward the notecard by about18 degrees at the neck: slightly lower the chin, show a little more of the top of the head, bring the facial plane toward the paper. Both round glossy eyes should clearly attend to the exact nib contact point on the card, with main white areas lowered within the eyes with a clear black margin. Preserve cute eye roundness and expression; no squashed or sliver eyes. The face must visibly read 'looking down and concentrating on writing', not looking at the camera. Head/neck remain anatomically connected and plush, not an image tilted flat. Keep a sweet small open smile with pink tongue.
Left paw (viewer's RIGHT) securely supports the SAME small rounded warm-cream card on the lap, angled gently up toward Buddy. Right paw (viewer's LEFT) HOLDS the forest-green/gold pen firmly: barrel passes through the gripping plush paw, with its middle portion hidden behind the paw and a convincing soft contact/occlusion shadow. Keep the pen close to the hand, short exposed nib section, no gap of air between hand and barrel, no detached wrist, no balancing pen beside the paw. Stubby plush grip, no human fingers. Pen nib visibly TOUCHES the card near its upper-left area. Keep the forearm bent naturally down to the paper. Do not make the pen so long that it extends across the face.
Keep the same seated body, camera distance and baseline, ears/paws/feet fully visible. Card is blank, no text/name/ink (app adds ONE line later). Render whole character and props together with consistent 3D lighting so there are no composited-looking edges. One full-body transparent alpha image, no background/ground/shadow/labels/contact sheet. The context is writing a child's name on this card. This is a STATIC new pose for approval before app/animation changes.
